# UC-LEARN13 — PingFederate RAR — the authorization server refuses an out-of-policy transfer

**Track:** learn  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  


## Buyer Story

An AI agent asks to move money for a user. The bank wants the authorization server, not the agent, to hold the line on whose accounts, how much and in what currency.

## PingOne Solution

PingFederate 13.1 receives the transaction as an authorization detail through PAR and runs a custom processor. It checks the request shape when it is pushed; after the user signs in it checks that the user is the one named, that both accounts are theirs and that the amount is within their limit. A request that fails is refused.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/pingfederate-ai-agent","label":"Open the PingFederate RAR demo"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `GUIDED_LEARNING`

## What to Say

> Run the allowed request: PingFederate asks the user to approve it and accepts it. Run the out-of-policy one: the processor refuses it after sign-in. The policy lives in PingFederate, not in the agent.
